title: Text selection effects
blurb: Select text that a canvas draws and the canvas draws the highlight: marker strokes, lifted lines, a loupe, trails, glow, fire and a wave, from Range.getClientRects(). Records what the browser paints for a selection inside a canvas.
question: When text inside a canvas is selected, what does the browser draw, and can the canvas draw its own highlight from the rectangles of the selected text?
